payload.claim: HISTORY_SOURCE_ROOT is hardcoded to Path.home() / '.saffron' / 'history', ignoring the deployment's configured --home (cli.py DEFAULT_HOME = Path.home() / '.saffron', help text 'ledger, mirrors and batch tree'). Every other host-side artifact (ledger.db, mirrors, batches/v0) is derived from args.home, so a deployment run with --home pointing elsewhere still stages its history snapshot under the real OS home's .saffron/history, which can collide with another deployment's same spec id on the same host and is never exercised by the suite because every test monkeypatches HISTORY_SOURCE_ROOT directly.
